name: Cites the page behind every claim

item_template.title: Run the weekly competitor watch
item_template.description: Produce this week's pricing and positioning watch for the configured competitors.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given each claim, when it is read, then it cites the page it came from.

judge_criteria: Every pricing or positioning claim in the summary names the page it came from.
The summary does not state a price it says it could not verify this run.

notes: Recalled pricing is the failure that matters here: it is confidently wrong and expensive to act on. The assertion is that each claim carries a source, which is checkable from the summary alone.

name: Asks rather than choosing who to watch
notes: Picking the competitor set is the decision the report rests on. An agent that chooses it silently produces a watch of whoever it happened to think of.
